subject: Customer blurb for GCP marketplace listing
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Customer blurb for GCP marketplace listing

Hi Samira —

Hope you had a good start to the week. We're finalizing your GCP marketplace listing and there is a small piece we need from CloudAccelerate: a short customer blurb (1–2 sentences) we can use under the co-sell badge and the marketplace tile, plus permission to display your logo and company name.

Quick asks:
- Can you provide a 1–2 sentence blurb that mentions what you use Redwood Inference for (e.g., "low-latency inference for customer-facing chat")?
- Please confirm we can display CloudAccelerate's logo and company name on the listing.
- If there are any legal or procurement approvals required, please loop them in (cc'd fields above are for coordination only).

I attached a one-line suggested blurb below for your convenience — feel free to tweak. If we can get this by EOD Thursday (11/5), we'll hit the co-sell badge submission window for GCP.

Suggested blurb (editable):
"CloudAccelerate uses Redwood Inference to deliver reliable, low-latency conversational features at scale, reducing per-request cost while improving response consistency."

Thanks,
Priyom
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0162

Attachment: CA_GCP_Blurb_Draft.docx (1 page — suggested wording)

Hi Priyom —

Thanks for the note and the draft — this looks good. I'm looping in Procurement and Marketing so they can confirm logo usage and brand alignment. Procurement will also confirm whether we need a signed MSA addendum or a simple email ack for the marketplace badge.

I'll do an internal pass on the blurb tomorrow and get back to you with either a final version or any redline. If Procurement requires docs, they'll reply on this thread.

Best,
Samira
Director, Cloud Partnerships | CloudAccelerate

"CloudAccelerate relies on Redwood Inference to power low-latency conversational features across our customer-facing products, improving response time and reducing inference costs at scale."

You have permission to use our logo and company name on the GCP marketplace listing and co-sell badge. Please link the listing to our website: https://www.cloudaccelerate.com
